text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"internal_researcher"},"campaign_name":"OER_NiFeCo_baseline_refresh_v3","campaign_class":"routine_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"confirm current plate before routine baseline refresh"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,25,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,-5],"thickness":200},"comment":"standard NiFeCo ternary baseline, Zn trim correction applied per calibration offset; vector sums to 100"},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":400,"duration":60,"substrate":"FTO"},"comment":"nominal anneal within standard window"},{"server":"measurement_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,25,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,-5],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"CP at standard OER current density, routine acquisition rate"},{"server":"model_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{},"comment":"ingest baseline point into surrogate"},{"server":"measurement_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,30,0,25,0,0,0,50,0,0,0,-5],"duration":120},"comment":"short durability check on calibrated baseline"}]}
